summary: Reproduced the Qwen3.8 prefilled-thinking failure in the Rust gateway parser: generated text beginning with reasoning and containing only </think> was returned entirely as normal content. Upgraded reasoning-parser to 1.3.0 and initialized non-streaming and per-choice streaming parser state from llm-tokenizer's detected thinking toggle, request override, and think-in-prefill metadata.

tests.what_was_measured: Issue-shaped regression failed because reasoning_text was empty instead of 'Compute 17 * 23. '. Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77c1a95a6944/failing-before.log
Both non-streaming and incremental streaming Qwen3 prefilled-reasoning regressions passed. Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77c1a95a6944/passing-after-prefill.log
Full gateway library suite: 396 passed, 0 failed. Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77c1a95a6944/cargo-test-lib.log
Rust formatting check passed; stable rustfmt only emitted warnings that two configured import-grouping options require nightly. Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77c1a95a6944/cargo-fmt.log

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU execution was used. The reproduced defect and correction are confined to deterministic Rust gateway response parsing after model generation.

remaining_limitations: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 weights and the reporter's NVIDIA L40S environment were unavailable, so no full-model HTTP or gRPC deployment was claimed.
The assigned gfx950 GPU was not relevant to this CPU-side parser defect; model architecture behavior beyond the supplied Qwen3.8 output shape remains unverified.
Two upstream candidate fixes were reviewed (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35249 and https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35346); both remained open at investigation time.
